name: AI Lead Qualification - Reliable Intake and Recovery

nodes.name: Receive Lead
nodes.notes: Public entry point. Header authentication runs before the workflow. Raw body is retained for HMAC verification.

nodes.name: Extract Raw Body
nodes.notes: Converts the preserved request bytes into the exact text signed by the website.

nodes.name: Calculate Request HMAC
nodes.notes: Signs timestamp.raw_body with the shared HMAC secret stored in n8n Credentials.

parameters.jsCode:
const rawBody = $('Extract Raw Body').item.json.data;
return { json: { ...$json, data: rawBody, calculated_signature: $json.calculated_signature || $json.data } };

nodes.name: Restore Signed Request Context
nodes.notes: Preserves the exact raw body and normalizes the Crypto result across n8n import/serialization behavior.

nodes.name: Verify and Validate Request
nodes.notes: Rejects stale/replayed signatures, malformed JSON, missing fields, invalid email, and oversized values before any paid API call.

nodes.name: Hash Normalized Lead
nodes.notes: The payload hash detects a reused submission_id carrying changed data.

nodes.name: Normalize Payload Hash
nodes.notes: Normalizes the SHA-256 output field before the atomic database claim.

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS d
), args AS (
  SELECT
    d->>'submission_id' AS submission_id,
    d->>'payload_hash' AS payload_hash,
    d->'lead' AS lead_payload,
    d->>'execution_id' AS execution_id
  FROM input
), inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO lead_automation.lead_processing (
    submission_id, payload_hash, lead_payload, status, attempt_count, locked_by, lock_until
  )
  SELECT submission_id, payload_hash, lead_payload, 'PROCESSING', 1, execution_id, now() + interval '5 minutes'
  FROM args
  ON CONFLICT (submission_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING *
), resumed AS (
  UPDATE lead_automation.lead_processing p
  SET locked_by = a.execution_id,
      lock_until = now() + interval '5 minutes',
      attempt_count = p.attempt_count + 1,
      last_error_code = NULL,
      last_error_message = NULL
  FROM args a
  WHERE p.submission_id = a.submission_id
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted)
    AND p.payload_hash = a.payload_hash
    AND p.status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED_PERMANENT')
    AND (p.lock_until IS NULL OR p.lock_until < now())
  RETURNING p.*
), chosen AS (
  SELECT i.*, 'NEW'::text AS claim_action FROM inserted i
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.*, 'RESUMED'::text AS claim_action FROM resumed r
)
SELECT * FROM chosen
UNION ALL
SELECT p.*,
  CASE
    WHEN p.payload_hash <> a.payload_hash THEN 'CONFLICT'
    WHEN p.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 'DUPLICATE'
    WHEN p.status = 'FAILED_PERMANENT' THEN 'FAILED_PERMANENT'
    ELSE 'ALREADY_PROCESSING'
  END AS claim_action
FROM lead_automation.lead_processing p
JOIN args a ON a.submission_id = p.submission_id
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chosen);

nodes.name: Claim Submission Atomically
nodes.notes: One parameterized JSON value avoids SQL injection and comma parsing. The primary key and lease make duplicate claims concurrency-safe.

nodes.name: Return Accepted
nodes.notes: The caller gets a fast response after durable claim. This node passes the item onward for background processing.

nodes.name: Recovery Every Five Minutes
nodes.notes: Retries only records whose previous processing lease expired and whose retry time has arrived.

parameters.query:
WITH exhausted AS (
  UPDATE lead_automation.lead_processing
  SET status = 'FAILED_PERMANENT',
      locked_by = NULL,
      lock_until = NULL,
      last_error_code = COALESCE(last_error_code, 'retry_limit_reached'),
      last_error_message = COALESCE(last_error_message, 'Automatic retry limit reached')
  WHERE status IN ('FAILED_LLM', 'FAILED_LLM_OUTPUT', 'FAILED_SHEETS', 'FAILED_NOTIFICATION')
    AND attempt_count >= 5
  RETURNING submission_id
), candidates AS (
  SELECT submission_id
  FROM lead_automation.lead_processing
  WHERE attempt_count < 5
    AND (
      (status IN ('PROCESSING', 'CLASSIFIED', 'SHEET_WRITTEN') AND next_retry_at IS NULL)
      OR (status IN ('FAILED_LLM', 'FAILED_SHEETS', 'FAILED_NOTIFICATION') AND next_retry_at <= now())
      OR (status = 'FAILED_LLM_OUTPUT' AND next_retry_at IS NOT NULL AND next_retry_at <= now())
    )
    AND (lock_until IS NULL OR lock_until < now())
  ORDER BY COALESCE(next_retry_at, received_at), received_at
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
  LIMIT 25
)
UPDATE lead_automation.lead_processing p
SET locked_by = $1::text,
    lock_until = now() + interval '5 minutes',
    attempt_count = p.attempt_count + 1
FROM candidates c
WHERE p.submission_id = c.submission_id
RETURNING p.*;

nodes.name: Add Runtime Configuration
nodes.notes: Non-secret values only. Production defaults to the real OpenAI endpoint. Replace spreadsheet and Slack IDs after import. Use the generated mock-test workflow only for zero-cost local testing. Secrets belong in n8n Credentials.

nodes.name: Prepare Strict AI Request
nodes.notes: Sends only the minimum business context. The prospect's phone and full email address are not sent to OpenAI.

nodes.name: Validate and Guard AI Result
nodes.notes: Recomputes the score and final label from bounded components. The model cannot override deterministic thresholds.

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS d), updated AS (
  UPDATE lead_automation.lead_processing p
  SET status = CASE
        WHEN i.d->>'error_class' = 'permanent_provider_configuration' THEN 'FAILED_PERMANENT'
        WHEN i.d->>'error_class' = 'invalid_structured_output' THEN 'FAILED_LLM_OUTPUT'
        ELSE 'FAILED_LLM'
      END,
      ai_call_count = p.ai_call_count + 1,
      next_retry_at = CASE
        WHEN COALESCE((i.d->>'retryable')::boolean, false)
        THEN now() + LEAST(interval '1 hour', power(2, GREATEST(p.attempt_count - 1, 0)) * interval '1 minute')
        ELSE NULL
      END,
      last_error_code = i.d->>'error_code',
      last_error_message = left(i.d->>'error_message', 500),
      locked_by = NULL,
      lock_until = NULL
  FROM input i
  WHERE p.submission_id = i.d->>'submission_id'
  RETURNING p.*
), event AS (
  INSERT INTO lead_automation.processing_events (submission_id, event_type, event_detail)
  SELECT submission_id, 'AI_FAILED', jsonb_build_object(
    'error_code', last_error_code,
    'status', status,
    'retryable', next_retry_at IS NOT NULL
  ) FROM updated
)
SELECT * FROM updated;

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS d), updated AS (
  UPDATE lead_automation.lead_processing p
  SET classification = i.d->'classification',
      guardrail_overridden = COALESCE((i.d->>'guardrail_overridden')::boolean, false),
      ai_model = i.d->>'ai_model',
      ai_call_count = p.ai_call_count + 1,
      ai_completed_at = now(),
      status = 'CLASSIFIED',
      next_retry_at = NULL,
      last_error_code = NULL,
      last_error_message = NULL
  FROM input i
  WHERE p.submission_id = i.d->>'submission_id'
  RETURNING p.*
), event AS (
  INSERT INTO lead_automation.processing_events (submission_id, event_type, event_detail)
  SELECT submission_id, 'CLASSIFIED', jsonb_build_object('qualification', classification->>'qualification', 'score', classification->>'score') FROM updated
)
SELECT * FROM updated;

nodes.name: Upsert Google Sheets Lead
nodes.notes: Append-or-update matches submission_id, so recovery updates an existing business row instead of blindly appending.
